
  The beam swept out across the water, as it had for a hundred and forty years. Owen sat on the iron stool and watched it turn. He poured his tea and raised the cup toward the dark horizon.

  "Good evening, Mary," he said. "Still the loneliest office in England. But somebody needed it tonight."

  Then he drank, and kept watch.
